In ancient Armenia, the Anahid temple was one of the most significant religious sites, and many pilgrims visited it to ensure the protection and welfare of their children.
data.spiritual_significance: Anahid represents the nurturing aspects of nature, providing sustenance to all life through water and fertility. Symbolically, her name signifies the importance of water as a source of life and spiritual renewal. Furthermore, Anahid is a protector of newborns, emphasizing the idea that new life and spiritual growth begin with the aquatic journey in the womb.
